name: OpenCL
scope: Both original extension files are independently built by the actual PoCL CPU OpenCL compiler as OpenCL C1.2, dispatched with 13 global work-items, and read back from a real OpenCL buffer. Eight trailing sentinel bytes remain unchanged. This is software CPU execution, not a physical GPU claim.
